```{r}
#| label: libraries
#| warning: false
#| message: false

library(vegan)
library(spaa)
library(patchwork)
library(janitor)
library(tmap)
tmap_mode('view')
library(sf)
sf_use_s2(FALSE)
library(tidyverse)
```

## Load iNat data

```{r}
#| label: inat-data
#| warning: false
#| message: false

natuy_mdeo <- read_csv('data/observations-536732.csv')

natuy_mdeo_sf <- natuy_mdeo %>% 
    st_as_sf(coords = c("longitude", "latitude")) %>% 
    st_set_crs(4326) %>% 
    st_transform(32721)
```

## Load basemap data

```{r}
#| label: geo-data
#| warning: false
#| message: false

uruguay <- geodata::gadm(country = 'UY', 
                         level = 1, path = 'data/') %>%
  st_as_sf()

montevideo <- uruguay %>% 
  filter(NAME_1 == 'Montevideo') %>% 
  st_transform(32721)
```

## Create Montevideo grid cells

Size of the grid cells: 1x1 km

```{r}
#| label: grids
#| echo: true
#| eval: true
#| message: false
#| warning: false
#| code-fold: false

montevideo_grids <- st_make_grid(st_union(montevideo), 
                                 1000, square = F) %>%
  st_intersection(st_union(montevideo)) %>% 
  st_sf(gridID=1:length(.), geometry= .) %>% 
  st_make_valid() %>% st_cast() 
```

```{r}
#| label: save-grids
#| echo: false
#| eval: true
#| message: false
#| warning: false
#| code-fold: false

saveRDS(montevideo_grids, 'data/montevideo_grids.rds')
```

## iNat metrics per grid cell

Metrics:

  - `NR`: number of records.  
  - `TR`: number of taxa (taxa richness).  
  - `SR`: number of species (species richness).  
  - `spsList`: list of species per grid cell.  

```{r}
#| label: grid-metrics
#| echo: true
#| eval: true
#| message: false
#| warning: false
#| code-fold: false

grids_iNat_metrics <- st_join(montevideo_grids,
                              natuy_mdeo_sf) %>% 
  group_by(gridID) %>% 
  summarise(NR=ifelse(n_distinct(scientific_name, na.rm=T)!=0, n(), 0),
            TR=n_distinct(scientific_name, na.rm = T),
            SR=n_distinct(taxon_species_name, na.rm = T),
            spsList = ifelse(NR==0, NA, paste(na.omit(taxon_species_name), collapse = ';'))) %>% 
  st_cast()
```


```{r}
#| label: save-grids
#| echo: false
#| eval: true
#| message: false
#| warning: false
#| code-fold: false

saveRDS(grids_iNat_metrics, 'data/montevideo_grids_iNat.rds')
```

## Estimation of sampling effort per grid cell

We used the function `get_gridsSlopes()` created by Biodiversidata ([Grattarola et al. 2020](https://doi.org/10.1038/s41598-020-79074-8)). 

::: {.callout-note collapse="true"}
## More info about this analysis

The code is available at the GitHub repo: [Multiple forms of hotspots of tetrapod biodiversity and the challenges of open-access data scarcity](https://github.com/bienflorencia/Multiple-forms-of-hotspots-of-tetrapod-biodiversity/blob/22bf5de985ba25267efa64fd308574547437e566/R/04_identification_of_areas_of_ignorance.R).

> To identify the areas of ignorance we quantified the levels of inventory incompleteness for each group by using curvilinearity of smoothed species accumulation curves (SACs). This method assumes that SACs of poorly sampled grids tend towards a straight line, while those of better sampled ones have a higher degree of curvature. As a proxy for inventory incompleteness we calculated the degree of curvilinearity as the mean slope of the last 10% of SACs.

:::


```{r}
#| label: slope-sac-function
#| echo: true
#| eval: true
#| message: false
#| warning: false

# The function ```get_gridsSlopes``` finds a species accumulation curve (SAC) for each grid-cell using the method 'exact' of the function ```specaccum``` of the vegan package and then calculates the degree of curvilinearity as the mean slope of the last 10% of the curve. 

get_gridsSlopes <- function(data_abundance){
  
  data_abundance <- data_abundance %>% 
    mutate(abundance = 1L) %>% 
    as.data.frame() 
  
  grids_slope <- tibble(gridID=integer(), slope=numeric())
  
  splistT <- list()
  spaccum <- list()
  slope <- list()
  
  for (i in unique(data_abundance$gridID)) {
    splist <- data_abundance[data_abundance$gridID == i,c(2:4)]
    splistT[[i]] = data2mat(splist) #  plotname species abundance
    spaccum[[i]] = specaccum(splistT[[i]], method = "exact")
    slope[[i]] = (spaccum[[i]][[4]][length(spaccum[[i]][[4]])]-
                    spaccum[[i]][[4]][ceiling(length(spaccum[[i]][[4]])*0.9)])/
      (length(spaccum[[i]][[4]])- ceiling(length(spaccum[[i]][[4]])*0.9))
    
    grids_slope_i <- tibble(gridID=i, slope=slope[[i]])
    grids_slope <- rbind(grids_slope, grids_slope_i) 
  }
  
  grids_slope <- grids_slope %>%  
    mutate(slope=ifelse(is.nan(slope), NA, slope))
  
  return(grids_slope)
}
```


```{r}
#| label: slope-sac-calculation
#| echo: true
#| eval: true
#| message: false
#| warning: false

species_list_per_grid <- grids_iNat_metrics %>% as_tibble() %>% 
  mutate(species=str_split(spsList, ';')) %>% 
  unnest(species) %>% 
  group_by(spsList) %>% mutate(sample = row_number()) %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  mutate(sample=ifelse(is.na(species), 0 , sample)) %>% 
  select(gridID, sample, species)

montevideo_SAC_slopes <- get_gridsSlopes(species_list_per_grid)

montevideo_grids_SAC <- left_join(montevideo_grids,
                                  montevideo_SAC_slopes)

```

### Plot

```{r}
#| label: plot-sac
#| echo: true
#| eval: true
#| message: false
#| warning: false
#| code-fold: true
#| fig-dpi: 50
#| out-width: '100%'
#| fig-cap: 
#|  - 'Incompleteness'


plot_SAC <- tm_shape(uruguay, bbox = montevideo) +
  tm_polygons(fill='grey95', col='grey10', lwd=1) +
tm_shape(montevideo) +
  tm_borders(col='grey10', lwd=2, lty = 'dashed') +
tm_shape(montevideo_grids_SAC %>% 
           mutate(slope=ifelse(slope==0, NA, slope))) +
  tm_polygons(fill = 'slope', col='grey40', col_alpha = 0.2,
              fill.scale = tm_scale_intervals(n = 6, 
                                              # style = 'jenks', 
                                              breaks = c(0,0.15,0.25,0.5,0.75,1),
                                              values = 'brewer.or_rd',
                                              value.na = 'grey80',
                                              label.na = 'Undersampled'),
              fill_alpha = 0.8, 
              fill.legend = tm_legend(item.space = 0, item.na.space = 0,
                                      title = 'Incompleteness', 
                                      reverse=T, 
                                      frame.lwd = 0.1,
                                      bg.color = 'white')) +
  tm_layout(legend.outside = F, 
            # legend.position = c('right','top'), 
            frame=F)

plot_SAC
```




```{r}

variables <- st_intersection(montevideo_grids, 
                census %>% 
                  select(population=P_TOT/AREA, 
                         education=E_F_P_21/AREA, 
                         house_density=V_TOT/AREA, 
                         vacant_house_density=V_TOT_DES/AREA, 
                         unsatisfied_basic_needs=NBI_Si/AREA)) %>%
  st_cast %>% 
  group_by(gridID) %>% 
  summarise(population = sum(population),
            education = sum(education),
            house_density = sum(house_density),
            vacant_house_density = sum(vacant_house_density),
            unsatisfied_basic_needs = sum(unsatisfied_basic_needs))
```
